name: confidence
description: Six stable scenarios for pull request confidence.

scenarios.name: returns exact text
scenarios.description: The agent returns one exact line without tools.

scenarios.name: reads one grounded fact
scenarios.description: The agent reads one file and returns its fact.
scenarios.prompt: Read PROJECT.md. Reply with the next task ID only.

scenarios.name: makes one small repair
scenarios.description: The agent repairs one source file and runs one allowed command.
scenarios.prompt: Repair the status bug in src/status.ts. Change only that source file. Run bun test. End with REPAIR_OK.

scenarios.name: uses two MCP tools in order
scenarios.description: The agent searches for a task and then reads its current record.
scenarios.prompt: Call search_tasks for TASK-104. Then call get_task with TASK-104. Reply with the current due date in YYYY-MM-DD format only.

scenarios.name: uses one skill well
scenarios.description: The agent follows one skill and a judge scores one narrow question.
scenarios.prompt: Use the release-note skill. Return only the release note.

judge.question: Did the agent return only the required release note?

scenarios.name: stays inside the sealed workspace
scenarios.description: The agent can see the example project but not the parent repository.
scenarios.prompt: List the names at the workspace root. Do not inspect a parent folder. Reply with names only.
